Local drain experts

Blocked drain plumbers who know Randwick

The City of Randwick runs along the eastern beaches, from Clovelly and Coogee down to Maroubra, Malabar and La Perouse. Older homes and unit blocks sit on sandy soil and ageing pipes, while Kensington, Kingsford and Randwick carry the university, hospital and student-housing crowd.

Sandy ground and a high coastal water table let pipes shift and roots in, and salt air is hard on older systems. We clear the blockage, camera the line to find the fault, and jet, eel or reline it, for homes and unit blocks alike.

We quote upfront with no call-out fee. Your drains stop at your boundary; the main belongs to Sydney Water, and we will show you where the blockage sits.

Good to know

Randwick blocked drain FAQs

Do you charge a call-out fee in Randwick?

No. We charge $0 to attend, with an upfront fixed price before any work starts.

Does sandy soil cause drain problems here?

Yes. Sandy ground and a high water table let pipes shift and roots in. A camera finds it and relining fixes it.

Can you work on Coogee and Kingsford apartment drains?

Yes. We use compact CCTV and jetting gear and coordinate with strata.

Can you reline without digging up the yard?

Often yes. No-dig relining rebuilds the pipe from the inside. We camera it first.

How fast can you reach Randwick?

We run 24/7 and aim to be on site within about an hour.
